title: Expectation of a product over a subset
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}$, let $g\colon\{-1,1\}\times\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $c\in\mathbb{R}$. If the uniform expectation of $g(a,b)$ over independent uniform signs $a,b$ equals $c$, then the uniform expectation over independent uniform sign vectors $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^d$ of $\prod_{i\in S}g(x_i,y_i)$ equals $c^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $d$ coordinates
$g$ is a real-valued function of two signs
The uniform expectation of $g$ on two independent uniform signs is $c$
